cases.expectation: A documentation deliverable requires and can prepare a patch transition.
A package.json JSON Pointer mirror follows the canonical version.
A pyproject.toml field mirror follows the canonical version without reformatting the document.
A nested plugin manifest mirror follows the canonical version.
release-check rejects any dirty working tree.
doctor rejects a mirror that differs from VERSION.
release-check rejects a version tag that identifies different content.
CI mode rejects a version that skips the next valid SemVer transition.
release-check rejects a proposed distribution SHA that is not exact HEAD.
An existing annotated tag on exact HEAD validates without requiring a second workflow.
Core doctor and release validation make no GitHub API request.
Nested package mirrors share the one repository version without component orchestration.
